summary: Form slider with a pixel track, a springy thumb, optional tick marks and a rolling value label with a prefix or unit.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Use with `onValueChange`. Snapped to `step` and clamped to `min`..`max` for display.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled. A form reset restores it.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment, greater than 0 (other values fall back to 1). Its decimal places set the display precision.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Draws a tick per step when there are 24 steps or fewer.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the formatted value, for example `€`.

props.name: unit
props.description: Text after the formatted value, for example `%`.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the track; also labels the thumb.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the thumb when there is no visible `label`.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; the value submits under it as a string.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the slider, ignores pointer and keyboard input and removes the thumb from the tab order.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every value change from dragging or keys.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called after each handled key press and when a drag ends, even if the value did not change.

keyboard.action: Change by a tenth of the range (at least one step), snapped to `step`.

accessibility: The thumb has `role="slider"`, `tabindex="0"`, `aria-labelledby` pointing at the label (or the `aria-label` prop when there is no `label`), `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and an `aria-valuetext` with the formatted value, including prefix and unit.
Pressing anywhere on the track moves focus to the thumb.
motion: With reduced motion the thumb moves to the value without the spring and the value label swaps without rolling.
form: With `name`, a hidden input submits the value as a string. There is no validation. Form reset restores `defaultValue` and calls `onValueChange` when that changes the value.
notes: Values are formatted with en-US digit grouping, for example `1,200`.
While dragging, the thumb follows the pointer exactly; a press without moving springs the thumb to the new value when released.
